summary: Explored Lasso demo landing and public RPC dashboard; captured screenshot and reviewed visible endpoint, routing/provider coverage, tester, and metrics areas without destructive actions.

findings.finding: Landing page positions Lasso as an RPC control plane with a JSON-RPC endpoint, smart routing, failover, observability, and cost control; primary CTAs include See it live, Use with your agent, Dashboard, and Read docs.
Screenshot evidence was captured for the initial product landing surface.
The public dashboard lists six supported chains and 35 providers, including Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and Sepolia variants, plus many named upstream RPC providers.
Dashboard includes an RPC Request Tester showing public profile and a 50 RPS limit, along with status legend states such as Healthy, Lagging, Recovering, Degraded, Rate Limited, Circuit Open, and WS.
Routing Profile metrics are visible for Public with RPS, success, latency, failovers, and a Live Activity panel waiting for requests.
Navigating directly to /docs returned a JSON Not Found response, suggesting the docs link/path may not be implemented at that route in this demo.

caveats: The Run control and some dashboard selector interactions were blocked by the safety policy, so no live RPC request was executed.
Clicking Metrics did not visibly change the dashboard content during observation.
Exploration was limited to same-origin product surfaces exposed through the lasso_demo_explore tool.
